name: The Road to Thornwick
introduction: Iselt nods. 'Then see us through the south gate of Thornwick. Four hours, if the axles hold.'
progress: The caravan is through the gate. Iselt will want to know.
completion: Iselt closes her ledger. 'Delivered. Welcome to Thornwick.'

name: Bales for the Ostler
introduction: Moss points at the stacked cotton. 'Into the warehouse, before the dew gets at it.'
progress: The bales are in the warehouse. Moss owes you two silver.

name: The Lost Wagons
introduction: Dravin grips your arm. 'Find the Hadda caravan, or find what happened to it.'
progress: The caravan's tracks end at a ring of old stones. Dravin should hear it.
completion: Dravin pays the finder's fee with a shaking hand.

name: The Buried Road
introduction: Tenko spreads a blank map. 'A buried road, hidden and walking. Three threads lead from here. Choose which to pull.'
progress: You have chosen a lead to follow along the Buried Road.
completion: The Buried Road lies open before you.

name: Lead: The Drowned Shrines
introduction: Sister Ama's drowned shrines lie in the marshes south and west.
progress: You have reached the drowned shrines.
completion: The shrines have given up their secret.

name: Lead: The Northern Milestones
introduction: Tenko's milestones run north, if the archive's oldest map is right.
progress: You have found the next milestone.

name: Lead: The Hill Folk
introduction: Garrow's hill folk live east, among the rings they will not touch.
progress: You have reached the hill folk.
completion: The hill folk have told you what they know.
